description: Geophysical Data - Next Generation Multi-Hazard Levee Assessment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Scott Brandenberg, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This data set contains the geophysical results obtained in support for "Next Generation Multi-Hazard Levee Assessment" of Bacon Island, and aims to characterize the internal structure and subgrade of the levees of Bacon Island. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fp5z-1a55. Keywords: Delta; Multi-hazard; geophysics; earthquake; flood; levee. Published 2021-12-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
